text: Did his stopping to tie his shoelace play a causal role in the accident?

Returning from the supermarket, the man stopped to tie his shoelace and deliberately set down an egg he had just bought on the front exterior of a stationary vehicle. The egg broke or smeared on a component of the vehicle’s windshield-wiper mechanism. Later, the driver operated the wipers, which transferred or smeared the egg into the driver’s line of sight, obstructing the view and contributing to a collision. If the man had not stopped and left the egg there, the accident would not have happened.

Returning from the supermarket, the man stopped to tie his shoelace and deliberately set down an egg he had just bought against a component of a stationary car’s windshield-wiper mechanism. The egg broke or smeared there. Later, the driver operated the wipers, whose movement transferred or smeared the egg into the driver’s line of sight, obstructing the view and contributing to a collision. The man was not directly involved in the accident, but his stop led him to leave the egg on the car, and without that, the accident would not have happened.
